title: Real Madrid sweep Murcia, earn Liga Endesa title
description: Murcia - Real Madrid 73-84 Real Madrid swept Murcia to earn Liga Endesa title. The guests trailed by 8 points at the halftime before their 52-33 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Real Madrid made 18-of-20 free shots (90.0 percent) during the game. Real Madrid had a 32-19 advantage in offensive rebounds. 25 personal fouls committed by Murcia helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. It was a great evening for Argentinian point guard Facundo Campazzo (180-1991) who led his team to a victory scoring 13 points, 7 rebounds, 6 assists and 4 steals. Bosnian swingman Dzanan Musa (205-1999) helped adding 18 points and 4 assists. The best for the losing side was Canadian-Jamaican guard Dylan Ennis (188-1991, college: Oregon) with 18 points and 5 rebounds and Cuban guard Howard Sant-Roos (201-1991, agency: Octagon Europe) scored 10 points and 5 rebounds.…
